meta_description: RR Bassi Handyman is your local Wolverhampton plumber. Fast repairs, honest pricing, and reliable service. Call 07846 352647 for emergency plumbing today.
hero_subhead: Burst pipes, leaks, or boiler trouble in Wolverhampton? We're here within hours, not days.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing Services for Wolverhampton Homes
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to routine maintenance, we fix it right the first time.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipe Repair
services.desc: Water damage spreads fast. We locate the leak, stop the flow, and repair or replace the damaged section — often on the same visit.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Service
services.desc: Faulty boiler? We diagnose the problem quickly and get your heating back on. Annual servicing keeps breakdowns at bay and saves you money.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: Cold radiators or leaking valves? We install new radiators, bleed air, and replace thermostatic valves to balance your heating efficiently.

services.title: Tap & Valve Repairs
services.desc: Dripping taps waste water and run up your bill. We replace washers, cartridges, and faulty valves with precision.

services.title: Toilet Repairs & Unblocking
services.desc: Blocked toilets or constantly running cisterns? We clear blockages and repair internal mechanisms to restore full function.

services.title: Pipe Leaks & Water Damage
services.desc: Slow leaks rot timber and damage ceilings. We trace the source, repair the pipe, and advise on drying out affected areas.

about_pullquote: I fix things right because my name's on the job.
about_para_1: RR Bassi Handyman has been serving Wolverhampton homes and businesses for over 15 years. We started with a simple idea: honest plumbing at fair prices, with no nonsense and no hidden costs. Today we've built a reputation for turning up on time, diagnosing problems properly, and getting the work done without fuss.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we treat their homes with respect and explain what we're doing in plain English. We carry common parts on the van, so most jobs finish in one visit. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned service, you get the same professional, straightforward approach every time.

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe under the kitchen at 11pm on a Saturday. Called RR and he was here by midnight, found the problem straight away, and had it fixed by 1am. Charged a fair rate and didn't patronise me with jargon. Brilliant bloke. Will use him again without hesitation.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: My boiler packed in during the cold snap. RR came the next morning, diagnosed a faulty pump, fitted a replacement, and tested everything. Very efficient, friendly, and the price was honest. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Annual service on the boiler and a new radiator valve fitted. RR explained everything as he went, didn't try to sell me stuff I didn't need, and finished bang on time. Exactly the kind of tradesman you want in your home.
reviews.author: Paul S.
